# Mehul Singh Teya

> Software Engineer specializing in frontend engineering, React, Next.js, TypeScript, scalable web applications, and high-traffic consumer products.

Website: https://zudoku.in/

## About

Mehul Singh Teya is a Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience building consumer-facing web products.

His primary expertise is frontend engineering using React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, and modern web technologies, with additional backend experience using Golang.

He has worked on high-scale consumer applications, payments, ticketing platforms, merchant dashboards, micro-frontends, and backend services.
